elements.content: Wet coats hang from every chair. Pale sunlight cuts through the storm residue on the windows.
Aria pins a hand-drawn map beside the console. Noah labels a notebook DAY TWO.
June tapes a new sign over the door: OPEN FREQUENCY.
Kell enters with a loaf of warm bread wrapped in foil. Maya follows close behind with a muddy, sleepy COMET in her arms.
He was under the vending machine in the band room.
Smart dog. Dry floor, free snacks.
June laughs, reaches for the microphone, and nods at Aria.
Red Creek, morning bulletin. East road is open, north shelter is stocked, and one missing dog has been recovered with zero remorse.
Noah pushes up a brass-heavy cassette cue. The room brightens with music.
Put that on repeat between updates.
No. Once is joy. Twice is branding.
The ON AIR sign steadies into a solid red glow as the four of them settle back to work.

data.heading: INT. COMMUNITY RADIO STUDIO - MORNING

narrative_beats.description: The studio at morning light — wet coats, a hand-drawn map, a notebook labeled DAY TWO — signals the crisis has not ended but the team has stabilized into a sustainable rhythm.

Comet is found under a vending machine in the band room — muddy and sleepy. Kell's observation ('Smart dog. Dry floor, free snacks.') delivers the missing-dog subplot's resolution as a light, earned joke.

June's morning bulletin — reporting the open road, stocked shelter, and recovered dog 'with zero remorse' — weaves the practical and the personal into a single broadcast, embodying the station's role as community anchor.

Noah cues a brass-heavy cassette and the room 'brightens with music.' The music is not incidental — it marks a collective emotional exhale. June's distinction ('Once is joy. Twice is branding.') uses wit to protect the moment's sincerity.

The ON AIR sign steadies into a solid red glow — contrasting with its flicker and failure in scene one — as the team settles back to work. The image closes the arc: the station is live, the community is connected, and the work continues.

tone_shifts: Opens in the muted exhaustion of aftermath, lifts into humor with Comet's return, then settles into a tone of steady, purposeful warmth as the broadcast resumes — a deliberate movement from survival mode to sustained presence.
